summary: Wrote a 4-phase implementation plan for the two lean guidance items. ITEM 1 (full-build phase-commit gate) is sequenced flow file first, then the standard agent, then the hard agent, because it revises three passages that currently instruct the opposite. ITEM 2 (plan-file section anchoring) lands narrowly in the same three files in generic wording, with the hard agent's copy self-contained since the flow file is not in its ambient context. Final phase runs a stale-phrase sweep, the deploy, and the complete gate set.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan revising the lean phase-commit build gate to a full library build and adding a plan-file section-anchoring rule across three source-store files.
